reconciliation.explanation: not rescaled (delivery spec). The span is 2.4 mm shorter than r1 because the r2 sections come from the master v15 wingtip (r1 used v12); the length differs by -1.1 mm: v17 spinner (-0.8 mm) and the rudder trailing edge, which is now the foam edge itself (r1 measured the marking shell standing proud of it). The manual length (1.040 m) is a listing value whose measuring stations are unknown.

landing_gear.suspension_clearance_note: the modelled leg link meets its foam bracket beyond about 6 deg; the 0-12 deg range is kept (reported in articulations.*.clearance, not clamped)

mass_properties.status: NON-FLIGHT PLACEHOLDER. The 1.46 kg ledger below is a modelling estimate and must not be used as flight data.

recommended_range_aft_of_LE_mm.source: 25-30 % MAC rule of thumb, not the manual

cg.note: CG kept as data, not as the model origin

inertia.note: can be derived from the component list if needed

tail_volume_horizontal.source: derived from the parametric CAD v12 (modelo_v12.py)

selected_reference_mass.source: manual reference selected by the integration team (delivery spec r2)
selected_reference_mass.note: use this value (with the simulator's own CG/inertia) for flight; r2 geometry does not define mass, CG or inertia

meshes.surfaces_over_budget_reason: 49 glTF primitives > 40: the crash split needs 21 separate meshes (one per section part) and each mesh needs one primitive per material it shows (wings 5: white foam, red/black paint, dark-grey brackets, nav lens). Merging colours would remove the paint scheme; textures were avoided by request (base colour only). All 10 materials are shared across meshes.

export.demo_animation: one 'control_demo' animation, one control at a time (timeline in source/_export_data.json)
export.tool: Blender 5.2.2 LTS (bpy module) + glTF 2.0 exporter io_scene_gltf2 5.2.40

generators.cad: build123d 0.13.0, Python 3.13 (master v15/v17 BREP caches; not shipped: CAD rebuild from this package is UNSUPPORTED)
generators.retessellation: source/scripts/retesela_r2.py (needs the master caches; output shipped in source/stl_juego_r2)

sections_rules.unused_note: wing_center is not used: the wing is two plug-in halves meeting on the symmetry plane, no centre section

closures.rule: faces of a section lying on another section (within 0.3 mm, facing it) are split off, painted the plain unpainted-foam colour (material 'white') and set 0.2 mm inside their own piece

detail.rule: same-direction coplanar area of different materials < 10 mm2

non_manifold_edges.note: open edges come from single-sided marking sheets (their hidden underside is removed) and from the split-off closure faces; every foam shell is closed
